# Just One Letter

> Just One Letter is an independent creative studio founded by Christopher Mosley. It makes apps and ideas that help people pray, reflect, and reconnect. The studio website is https://just1letter.com. Two iOS apps are on the App Store today: Metanoia Prayer, a quiet Christian place to pray and begin again, and First Love: Jesus First, a Jesus-first spiritual formation app for relationships. First Love is not a dating app and is not therapy.

Just One Letter began with a change in Christopher's own name: Chris + t = Christ. The "t" points to the cross, and Christopher means "bearer of Christ." Faith is at the center of the work, with care in the details.

Prayer, journaling, and reflections in both apps stay on the device. Neither app requires an account or sign-in. The App Store privacy labels state that neither app collects data. Core prayer and reflection practices stay free. Optional paid layers are available through Apple In-App Purchase. Prices may vary by region. There is no Android app at this time.

Stillpoint Reflection and Together are taking shape and are not released. Canticle is a worship lyric display in build now and is not yet released.

Questions, ideas, or a note to say hello are welcome at hello@just1letter.com.

## Apps

- [Metanoia Prayer on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/metanoia-prayer/id6791059834): A quiet Christian iOS app to pray, reflect, and begin again. Not a streak and not a score. A practice of returning. Includes Today's Anchor (a verse and a short reflection for the day), Prayer Moments (five gentle invitations across the day, shaped by your schedule), guided prayer (Structured Prayer walks through Praise, Repent, Ask, and Yield; Contemplative Prayer moves through Arrive, Notice, Offer, and Receive; Return to Sender helps you release what you were carrying; a silent sit is there too), and a private on-device journal. Prayer stays free. Digital Metanoia is an optional Apple In-App Purchase (Monthly $4.99, Yearly $29.99, or Lifetime $59.99, USD as listed). Requires iOS 16.6 or later. Bundle ID: com.metanoia.prayer. Published by Christopher Mosley.

- [First Love: Jesus First on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/first-love-jesus-first/id6810749214): A Jesus-first iOS app that helps Christians return to Jesus as first love, so earthly relationships can be honest and lasting. Not a dating app, and not therapy. Includes Daily Anchors in Scripture, Guided Settling Paths, Thought Screen for structured local reflection, and a private on-device journal. Everyone gets Daily Anchors, core teaching, 3 Thought Screens a week, and the first 3 steps of each path. First Love+ is an optional subscription that opens every path and unlimited Thought Screens (Monthly $9.99, or Yearly $69.99 with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, USD as listed). Requires iOS 15.0 or later. Bundle ID: com.srndr.firstlove. Published by Christopher Mosley.

- [Christopher Mosley on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/christopher-mosley/id6791059836): The developer page for both live apps.

## Website

- [Just One Letter](https://just1letter.com/): Studio home. The story behind the name, the apps, and a way to say hello.
- [Projects](https://just1letter.com/projects): Work in progress from the same studio behind the apps.
- [Canticle](https://just1letter.com/canticle): A worship lyric display in build now, not yet released. Built so a small church can present lyrics in time with the song, full screen or to a projector, without someone driving the slides. It also shows key and tempo for the people leading worship. Audio is processed on the computer and is never uploaded.
- [FAQ](https://just1letter.com/faq): Short answers to common questions about the studio and the apps.

## Support and privacy

- [Metanoia Support](https://justoneletter.github.io/): How to get help, what stays free, and how to manage Digital Metanoia. Support: hello@just1letter.com.
- [Metanoia Privacy Policy](https://justoneletter.github.io/privacy.html): Journal entries and prayer preferences stay on the device. There is no Metanoia cloud journal.
- [First Love Support](https://justoneletter.github.io/first-love-support.html): Help for First Love: Jesus First, including how to manage First Love+ and restore purchases. Support: hello@just1letter.com.
- [First Love Privacy Policy](https://justoneletter.github.io/first-love-privacy.html): Local-only. No account. Journal entries and reflections stay on the device.
- [Apple Standard EULA](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/): Terms of Use for both apps.

## Optional

- [justoneletter.github.io](https://github.com/justoneletter/justoneletter.github.io): GitHub repository that holds the studio site (in the studio folder) along with app support and privacy pages.
